item.title: ‘We Will Safeguard Our Vital Interests in Any Scenario,’ Netanyahu Says After Talking with Trump
item.description: After speaking with President Donald Trump on Monday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced that his country will do whatever it takes to defend itself, regardless of any agreement the U.S. strikes with the terrorist Iranian regime. Netanyahu detailed his conversation with Trump in a video posted on his X.com account. In it, he reports that Trump is confident that an acceptable agreement to achieve U.S. military objectives can be reached with Iran:
